object.description: Setup: a saved route with a quickest continuous 1 km, 5 km and 10 km segment not starting at a split boundary, computed independently from the GPX export; repeat with the distance unit mile. Steps: 1. Open the Stats screen. 2. Read the records. Expected: Each record equals the independent time of the quickest continuous segment and shows its date, and stays 1, 5 and 10 km in mile mode.
